corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: The official conclusions and same-day release verify the document and its adoption/publication. The education section contains a dedicated operative request to examine measures addressing skills challenges linked to AI. That is substantive enough for direct AI relevance, but only for education; it does not support general-cross-sector or employment tagging and is not recast as a precursor.
